title: 情報工学入門とキャリアデザイン
subtitle: Introduction to Information Engineering and Career Design
teachers:
FUJIMOTO Taro
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1)	learn about the connection between engineering and society, as well as the connection between engineering and the local community.
(2)	learn about the history of those technologies and the technologies of the present and future, and clarify their consciousness in relation to becoming an “engineer who thinks and acts independently”.
advice:
This is an introductory course to engineering (Information and Computer Science). We will cover the following materials:
1.	Understanding of the College of Engineering: Students are expected to learn and understand the history of the related fields of the College of Engineering, the role and importance of the current and future fields, and the importance of standardization through lectures by teachers and engineers working in society.
2.	Understanding of the Department of Information and Computer Science: Students are expected to understand the curriculum in the Department of Information and Computer Science (ICS), the expansion of "areas of study", and their relationship with society.
3.	Exercises that foster the ability to think logically about the essence of phenomena and things (scientific skills): Students are expected to understand the role that information engineering has played in society, culture, and history through concrete examples. In order for them to take on such roles, the knowledge and basic skills acquired in the department are important.
4.	Introduction of research fields: Students are expected to understand the contents of the "areas of study" in the department of ICS and research efforts in that area.
5.	Comprehensive exercises: Students engage in exercises and group activities based on their portfolios and the tasks given in classes to date, and then submit the result as reports to confirm them.

requiredKnowledge: It is important for students to pay close attention to the technologies they are interested in, and then to tackle those subjects proactively and voluntarily so that they can understand the “areas of study” of the department including the past, present, and future prospects of their research fields. They must also formulate learning objectives and learning plans for future specialized subjects, and determine the direction of their success in their future of society.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the role of the College of Engineering in society and make individualized study plans.
Be able to understand research fields of the department, and consider future study methods and course plans.
Be able to explain the mechanism of a computer and the role of programming.
Be able to explain the role of solutions using information technology.
Be able to explain how services provided by information technology work.
Be able to describe their career development process in their own words and communicate it to third parties.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1)	Be able to understand and explain the interrelationship between other fields of engineering and information engineering.
(2)	Be able to acquire basic knowledge in a wide range of fields related to information engineering, clarify their learning objectives, study consciousness as future information engineers, and work on studying with enthusiasm.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1)	Be able to understand the interrelationship between information engineering and other fields of engineering.
(2)	Be able to acquire basic knowledge in a wide range of fields of information engineering, show interest in the usefulness of information engineering, clarify learning objectives and study consciousness, and actively engage in study.
